parameters.query:
SELECT 'nuevo' AS tipo, c.name AS competidor, p.title AS producto, p.sku, p.url,
       NULL AS antes, s.price AS ahora, p.first_seen AS fecha
FROM products p
JOIN competitors c ON c.id = p.competitor_id
LEFT JOIN product_snapshots s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.captured_at = p.first_seen
WHERE p.first_seen >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND c.name NOT IN ('Fitness Tech', 'Fitness Tech FR', 'Fitness Tech PT')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'precio' AS tipo, c.name AS competidor, p.title AS producto, p.sku, NULL AS url,
       pe.old_price AS antes, pe.new_price AS ahora, pe.detected_at AS fecha
FROM price_events pe
JOIN products p ON p.id = pe.product_id
JOIN competitors c ON c.id = p.competitor_id
WHERE pe.detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND c.name NOT IN ('Fitness Tech', 'Fitness Tech FR', 'Fitness Tech PT')

ORDER BY competidor, fecha DESC;
